Key technical safeguards include: data encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+ or 1.3) and at rest (AES-256), unique user identification and multi-factor access controls, automated session timeouts, immutable audit logging with log retention for at least 6 years, and signed Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) with cloud providers.
